Make the board, notebook and task panel more compact.

- Board cards are about 15% shorter, with smaller row spacing and timeline headers.
- Thread labels and the notebook sidebar take less horizontal space.
- Toolbars use smaller controls and margins; notebook headings and text are more compact.
- The task panel is narrower, with tighter task spacing.

The existing Notebook/Board and Tasks buttons remain. Horizontal zoom settings are preserved.

Validated with twenty-nine unit tests, official Obsidian lint, strict TypeScript, package checks and native visual inspection of the board, notebook, tasks and folded threads in the canonical development vault.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publication.
